quest.title: Springs and Trail History Hunt
quest.description: Locate three historical park markers along the paved trail and write down the year established listed on each one.
steps: Walk along the main paved multi-use trail originating from the historic brick waterworks building.
Inspect the informational plaques and trail markers encountered along the path to find three distinct installation dates.
Record the three specific years found on a personal notebook or device.
You're done when you have written down three distinct historical years from the park markers.
